limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.description: Last dates to file, computed from your counsel's reviewed rule table.
limitation.verifyLabel: Computed from your counsel's rule table. Verify before relying on it.
limitation.gatedNotice: A computed date is a proposal. Nothing is filed or scheduled until you confirm it, and confirming adds an obligation to the matter.
limitation.offline: You are offline. Limitation dates are read-only until you are back online.

empty.title: No limitation dates yet
empty.body: Propose a date for a matter from a reviewed rule, then confirm it once you have checked it.

noRules.title: No reviewed rule table
noRules.body: A date is only computed from a rule your counsel has reviewed. Ask your administrator to import and review a rule table.

steps.title: How this date was computed
steps.condonable: Delay may be condoned on application.

error.invalid: Check the matter, rule and start date.
error.conflict: No reviewed rule is available for that choice.
error.failed: Could not complete that. Try again.
